sections.heading: 1. Wall calf stretch
lines: ① Hands on a wall, step one foot back.
② Back heel down, back knee straight.
④ Gentle walking during the day can help too.

skip the stretch and see your GP promptly.

caption:
Koko keeps waking at 3am with a calf locked tight. Night cramps are common, and they can become more frequent as we get older.

The exact cause is often unclear. When one hits, gently pull your toes towards you and take a few slow steps.

Hybi's bedtime routine: a wall calf stretch, 30 seconds, 2–3 times each side. Staying active through the day can help too.

A swollen or warm calf, cramps waking you most nights, or legs feeling weak are worth getting checked. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio 🐨

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
